title: FilmCraft agent-pipeline integration contract (documentation-level sketch)
purpose: A concrete, reusable integration contract skeleton showing how an external agent pipeline can connect to FilmCraft v0.15.0's documented MCP server and JSON control channel. Captures interface assumptions, known gaps, and per-interface failure modes derived from the documentation at commit 6c2825bc. Nothing is built or run; this is a protocol-level reference.
